entities.summary: Sergei Alekseevich Kapustin was a Soviet ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for Neftyanik Ukhta from his hometown, HC CSKA Moscow, Krylya Sovetov Moscow, and HC Spartak Moscow.
